remarks: Rare opportunity to build new in an established Lancaster neighborhood! Situated on an impressive .87-acre lot measuring approximately 73' x 497', this property offers the space and flexibility to create the home you've been looking for. The Town of Lancaster has confirmed the property as a Lot of Record, allowing for the construction of a new single-family home if the existing structure is removed. Based on the Town's calculations, a home of up to approximately 54' width may be possible, with 35' front and rear setbacks. Unlike starting with a completely undeveloped parcel, this cleared property already offers an existing driveway, detached two-car garage with electric, public water, sewer and electric connections. With nearly 500' depth, there's plenty of room to envision a beautiful new home along with an exceptionally spacious and private backyard. Bring your builder, your plans and your vision—this is a unique opportunity to build new while enjoying nearly an acre in a convenient, established location. Staircase not useable.
